name: Awara Shinobu
source: A second-year student who is popular with the girls because of her mature, cool and prince-like personality. Shinobu is is secretly an otaku but keeps her hobbies and interests a secret from everyone else. She is also [url=/c14402]Nanase's[/url] best friend and was invited to the Tennis Club by her, but as of late Shinobu has been thinking whether she truly wants to continue playing tennis or not.
